title: Mixed Event — To You, My Caring Companion — Episode7 Put Your Heart Into It

meta.Episode: Episode7 — Put Your Heart Into It
meta.Event Outline: Honami notices that Kanade has been more focused than ever on composing lately. When Emu gives her tickets to a bridal fair, Honami decides to invite Kanade in the hope of her employer taking a break.

rows.Line: A few hours later
Phoenix Bridal Fair Venue

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wow, we did so much today!
We got to see a bunch of dresses and all the booths were super fun...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Our show was also really, really fun!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Totally! Plus, Kanade, Honami, you two looked so amazing in your dresses! That was a nice cherry on top!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Haha... I'm still a little embarrassed. But the dresses you and Emu chose also suited you both really well!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I agree. The normal mock wedding you two did after us was nice to watch.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe. That was really fun!
Thanks for doing that with me, Emu♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Your fluffy and sparkly dress was so cute☆

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Unfortunately, it's getting pretty late...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, Honami has to work today, right? I guess we should start getting ready to head out, then.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I kinda wanna take a look at what souvenirs they have first. Can you stay just a tad longer, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I should have time for that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay. Then, let's cap off our trip by browsing through the souvenir section.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Oh, right... It's a bit late, but I should give Rin a chance to see the fair.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Um, sorry...
There's actually something at the booth over there that I was meaning to buy...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
There is?
Then, should we head over there first?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, that's okay...!
Please go ahead and browse through the souvenirs!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll need a minute, but I'll be back soon.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Got it!
We'll see you in a bit!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Have fun, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, let's go see what souvenirs they've got!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Is there anything you wanna get, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Actually, would you mind if I asked you two for a favor first...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, this seems like a good place...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Rin, the coast is clear.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Okay!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making you wait so long.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <That's totally fine! I actually managed to sneak in a few peeks and heard some of what you were all talking about!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Your acting was so cool during that show, Hona♪>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: R-Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Haha! Hona, your face just turned bright red!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Anyway, I'll show you around the fair.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Thanks!
I wanna see the places that you recommend♪>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Sure. Then, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, first... This is the wedding dress exhibit.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Wow! These dresses are so pretty!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<I wish I could try some on!
Oh, what's this one called?!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that one's a...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Oh, Hona, look at the models!
Everyone looks so sparkly!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, they do. I think they're having their fashion show now. Would you like to take a quick peek?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, I wanna see!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Whoa! It's a real wedding hall!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<You can be in a mock wedding here, right?!
I wish I could be in one...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I may actually be able to make a veil for you... We can try having one in SEKAI the next time I'm there with the others.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Really?! Woohoo☆>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<*Sigh*
That was so much fun. Thanks for showing me around, Hona!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Oh, that reminds me...
How's that person you invited doing? Did she enjoy herself today?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, she enjoyed herself very much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And it's all because you said I should invite her, Rin. Thank you very much for making that suggestion.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Really?! That's great to hear!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But you deserve more credit for doing all the hard work, Hona! I'm so glad she's all smiles now!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, I'll make sure to bring the souvenirs you picked out over to SEKAI later. Please look forward to them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Awesome☆
Hehe. I can't wait!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Then, I think I'm gonna head back.
Thanks so much for today, Hona☆>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm glad you enjoyed everything so much, Rin. I'll see you later in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Okay, see you! Bye bye!>

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Bridal Fair Venue

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's see... The others should be...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Ms. Yoisaki! There you are.
Wait, where are Mizuki and Emu...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Welcome back, Ms. Mochizuki.
They're browsing through souvenirs right now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm a bit tired, so I decided to rest here in the meantime.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
Then, let's wait for them together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I had a lot of fun today because of you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm so happy to hear you say that...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Thank goodness...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I wasn't sure if I should at first, but I'm really glad I invited her out today.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, sorry. Someone must've just sent me a message. But who...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... Is everything okay...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, um, yes...
It's nothing serious...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The friend I told you about before just contacted me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I've been talking to her during the day lately, but she apparently won't be available tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Did something happen...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, no trouble or anything.
Just student council business.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, everything's fine.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, really. Everything's fine...
I was just a little surprised to receive a message from her is all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
I'm sorry for looking so worried.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, would you like something warm to drink? It is starting to get a little chilly.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'll go buy us something.
What would you like to have?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Hm... Then, tea might be nice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, I'll be right back.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, tea and water.
That should do it...
<Hona.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? Rin...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Sorry, I'm still here...
I sorta didn't want to go back so soon.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Also, is that the person you were talking about? Ms. Yoisaki, right...?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... Yes, that's her.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Is everything okay...?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, everything's fine.
I was just thinking...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: When I saw Ms. Yoisaki smile, I felt like I'd managed to help her feel better...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I actually accomplished very little.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hona...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's nothing to be surprised about, of course. I knew that cheering her up a little wouldn't actually solve what's going on with her and her friends...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I knew that, but my mind keeps wandering back towards it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But I still think you did a really great thing today, Hona...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I mean, I'd be beyond happy if I saw someone trying to do so much for me!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I know! Hona, remember those vows you told me about earlier?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <The thing about being with the person you care about for better or for worse?!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hearing that almost brought me to tears! I mean, it's such a beautiful thought... Promising to be with someone through thick and thin no matter what!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <So, even when Ms. Yoisaki thinks things are tough or tires herself out from trying so hard... I'm sure she feels better knowing that you're there for her!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, you think so...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah! Which is why what you did for her today's gotta mean a lot to her...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<And everything you usually do is really amazing too!
There's no two ways about it!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Am I wrong? You're always thinking about what's best for Ms. Yoisaki, right?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You make all this delicious food for her, clean her house, do her laundry... You put your whole heart into it...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <That's why I think you're a humongous source of support for her!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I think I see what you mean...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you, Rin.
I feel a little better now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Hehe. Great!
I feel better too after seeing you smile☆>
